items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: And Frank cut us off from the bar, he says, don't give him anymore to drink.

ctx.x: Frank Rupneck. Well, now, it just happened that in that period I was using two trumpet players. One would come in at 9:00 and play til 12:00, and one would come in at 12:30 and go till 3:00. It was a 9:00 to 3:00 job. Now, Frank bought the band a drink and the new trumpet player has gone up there. He hasn't played yet. We got to play Rampart.
Well, you know what happened to his lip? He just blew the number. And Frank cut us off from the bar, he says, don't give him anymore to drink.
